terms.title: Intego
terms.body: Iyi nyandiko igaragaza imiterere y'agateganyo y'amabwiriza yo gukoresha AWA.

terms.title: Gukoresha porogaramu
terms.body: AWA itanga ibikoresho byo kwikurikirana no kwita ku mibereho myiza. Ibikubiyemo byanyuma bisobanura uburenganzira n'inshingano by'abakoresha bizongerwamo nyuma y'uko isuzuma ry'amategeko rirangira.

terms.title: Kuboneka kwa serivisi
terms.body: Amabwiriza yanyuma agenga kuboneka, gusana no guhinduka kwa serivisi aracyategereje kwemezwa.

terms.title: Twandikire
terms.body: Amakuru yemewe yo kuvugana natwe azongerwamo nyuma y'uko ikipe ya AWA iyemeje.

privacy.title: Amakuru ajyanye
privacy.body: Iki gice kizasobanura neza amakuru atunganywa na AWA n'impamvu yabyo, nyuma y'uko isuzuma ry'amategeko rirangira.

privacy.title: Kubika no gucungira umutekano
privacy.body: Inyandiko yanyuma izagaragaza ingamba zo kubika, uburyo bwo kurinda n'igihe amakuru abikwa.

privacy.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
privacy.body: Uburyo bwo kugera ku makuru yawe, kuyakosora cyangwa kuyasiba buzasobanurwa mu nyandiko yemejwe.

privacy.title: Kuvugana ku bijyanye n'ibanga
privacy.body: Aderesi yemewe yo kuvugana n'ushinzwe ibanga izongerwamo mbere yo gutangaza.

imageAlts: Ishusho: muganga n'umugore utwite mu isuzuma bakoresha ultrasound. Inyandiko: Ubuvuzi mu gihe cy'inda, ku buzima bwa mama no ku mibereho myiza y'umwana.
Ishusho: umugore utwite yirambuye mu buryo bwa lunge ku ikoborera rya yoga. Inyandiko: Ikore kugira ngo inda igende neza. Igitabo cyamamaza: mama ufite ubuzima bwiza ku mwana ukura neza.
